content: Cuberto (award-winning digital studio) uses: nav (Services/Projects/About/Blog/Contacts), hero with positioning statement, 'What we do' services grid (5 services), client logos trust bar, portfolio case studies (10+ with outcome descriptions), client testimonials (4 quotes), credentials section (years/projects/awards), FAQ addressing process and pricing questions, blog (3 recent articles), contact with office locations. Key conversion elements: explicit outcome-focused case study descriptions, FAQ pre-handles pricing and tech choice objections, blog adds SEO surface area. Services are descriptive ('We design and build digital products') not jargon. Testimonials focus on results and collaboration quality.
